query: Oh my gosh, you’ll never guess what happened on my walk earlier today — I ran into the sweetest little golden retriever puppy that kept trying to tug on my shoelaces, and its owner even let me give it a tiny peanut butter treat I had in my bag. Then when I got home, my new houseplant I ordered last week finally perked up after I gave it some extra sunlight and a little bit of plant food this morning. I was also so excited last night because I finally beat that tricky final level of the puzzle game I’ve been playing for weeks, I even did a little happy dance when I finished it. Anyway, I need to request a return for my delivered order #W5490111, the items I want to return are 4579334072, 6117189161 and 4947717507, and I’d like the refund to go back to my credit_card_3124723 please.
